units.source_text: 众侍女皆忙于准备迁居，各人把自己的梳子、盒子、柜子以及其他种种打包装袋的东西先已运往京中。

en.t: All the ladies-in-waiting were busy preparing for the move, and each had already sent her own combs, boxes, cabinets, and all the other packed belongings on ahead to the capital.

units.source_text: 落叶公主不能一人独留山庄，只得啼啼哭哭地登车。

en.t: Princess Ochiba could not remain alone at the mountain villa, so she had no choice but to board the carriage in tears.

units.source_text: 临别只管注视四周，回想当初来时，老夫人在病苦中抚摸她的头发，替她整理，

en.t: At the moment of departure she kept looking all around, remembering how, when she first came, the old lady had stroked and arranged her hair despite her illness,

units.source_text: 然后相扶下车，景象历历在目，不觉悲从中来，泪盈于睫。

en.t: and then how they had supported each other as they got down from the carriage; the scene rose vividly before her eyes, and sorrow welled up before she knew it, filling her lashes with tears.

units.source_text: 老夫人所遗佩刀及经盒，一向不离身畔，此时也随身带去。

en.t: The short sword and sutra box left by the old lady had always stayed close beside her, and now she took them with her as well.
